name: Comic Con Stockholm
blurb: Sweden's largest pop-culture meeting place, held in Stockholm as separate Winter and Summer editions each year.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'STOCKHOLMSMÄSSAN 30 OCT - 1 NOV 2026 WINTER EDITION'; address block: 'Stockholmsmässan Mässvägen 1, 125 80 Älvsjö' (Älvsjö is part of Stockholm).
Homepage text: 'KISTAMÄSSAN 8-9 MAY 2027 SUMMER EDITION'; address block: 'Kistamässan Arne Beurlings Torg 5, 164 40 Kista' (Kista is part of Stockholm).

notes: Treated as one brand with two Stockholm-area shows per year (Winter at Stockholmsmässan/Älvsjö, Summer at Kistamässan/Kista), per RESEARCH.md's two-shows-a-year rule. Winter guest cards give only a role label ('Actor', 'Voice Actor', 'comic artist', 'creator', etc.) with no specific show/credit, so Known for is left blank except where the card named a specific role beyond the category (Annalise Bissa 'editor', Perik 'Youtuber', the two cosplay guests). Skipped a 'Coming soon' placeholder tile in the Cosplay Guests section. The Summer line-up page shows only a 'more info soon' (alt text: mer info snart) placeholder image, no names yet, so that edition's guests is none-yet.
